Rate-gram: the astronomical template as a spectrum over sedimentation rate, per window

Source: R/plot_chirp_eha.R
rate_gram.Rd

A purely spectral estimate of the sedimentation rate along a record, without any tracking: for every window of analyse_chirp_eha (criterion = "template") the template score (the summed log line-to-continuum ratio at the periods of all astronomical cycles, the cyclostratigraphic counterpart of the harmonic product spectrum used for pitch detection in speech and music) is taken at its best gradient and shown against the rate; its maximum per window is the spectral rate estimate, optionally median-filtered over a few windows. On CIP Case 3 the maximum per window correlates 0.56 with the true rate, the median over 11 windows 0.73 (the tracked rate of track_chirp_hmm, which adds continuity, 0.97).

Usage

rate_gram(
  ce,
  k = 11,
  plot = TRUE,
  rate_unit = c(1, "depth units / kyr"),
  reference = NULL,
  main = NULL
)

Arguments

ce

Chirp-matched EHA result: the list returned by analyse_chirp_eha run with criterion = "template" (it must contain template_score_all and sedrate_grid). Required, no default.

k

Width, in windows, of the running median applied to the best rate per window (integer, >= 1; even values are rounded up to the next odd number, 1 means no smoothing). Default=11.

plot

Draw the rate-gram (map of the template score against sedimentation rate and depth, with the best rate per window as white points and its running median as a white line) (logical, TRUE or FALSE); with FALSE only the list is returned. Default=TRUE.

rate_unit

Conversion factor and label of the rate axis: a vector c(factor, "label") whose first element multiplies the rates (in depth units per kyr) for the axis labels, e.g. c(100, "cm/kyr") for a depth axis in metres. Only changes the labelling. Default=c(1, "depth units / kyr").

reference

Reference sedimentation-rate curve drawn as a red dashed line for comparison: a two-column matrix or data frame with depth in column 1 and rate (depth units per kyr) in column 2; NULL draws none. Default=NULL.

main

Title of the plot (character); NULL gives a default title. Default=NULL.

Value

A list with depth, sedrate (rate grid), map (rates x windows), best (the maximum per window) and smooth (its running median).
